assets.generation_summary: SVG/CSS/GSAP HyperFrames scene. Abstract semiconductor wafer: circular graphite disc, cyan die-map grid (die cells + micro-grid at 30px intervals), amber catchlight sweep animation, Ken Burns 1.03x scale over 23s. Two bone text overlays timed to narration beats. Substitutes for deferred ComfyUI wafer image (d6 — ComfyUI GPU allocator failure, local compatibility issue not a provider failure).

SVG/CSS/GSAP HyperFrames scene. Simplified geometric EUV machine schematic: source column, optics tower (3 mirror elements), wafer stage, connecting rails. Cyan beam line draws across frame at ~8s (narration beat 'extreme ultraviolet light'). Amber process point grows on wafer stage. $20B+ stat card (amber border) at ~16s. 'Decades of data. Not a blueprint.' text beat at ~32s. 4 distinct state changes across 40s. No trademarked branding. Substitutes for deferred ComfyUI EUV image (d6).

SVG/CSS/GSAP HyperFrames scene. Industrial fab building silhouette: primary cleanroom block with amber face highlight (leftmost third), utility block, mechanical services block, construction crane (signals under-construction), desert perspective grid, distant second building. Node-generation stat card (red #D64545 border): 3 GSAP stagger lines — 'Arizona: N4 Now' (bone) / 'N3: est. 2027' (muted steel) / 'N2: No date set' (muted steel, dimmer). Arrow motif + 'Two generations behind Taiwan's leading edge' caption. Red border only use of red in video — per brand rules. Substitutes for deferred ComfyUI Arizona fab image (d6).

SVG/CSS/GSAP HyperFrames scene. Abstract convergence diagram: source nodes (Apple/NVIDIA/AMD/Qualcomm/AI Data Centers) with cyan routes converging into one amber TSMC/Taiwan chokepoint node. No world map.

metadata.comfyui_images_reason: ComfyUI v0.13.0 GPU allocator failure (torch_vram_total: 0 despite 23GB VRAM free). ComfyUI-internal issue, not VRAM contention. See decision_log d6. Post-run diagnostic task created. Images replaced with svg_native HyperFrames scenes.

metadata.gpu_execution_order: CPU: author HyperFrames SVG/CSS scenes -> GPU: Fish Speech chunked narration -> GPU (optional): ACEStep music -> compose
metadata.fallback_policy: If Fish Speech unavailable after ComfyUI unload, escalate to user before switching to paid TTS. If ACEStep music fails quality gate, proceed without music (silence policy).
metadata.narration_fix_reason: Previous full-section generations truncated at ~47.5s due to max_new_tokens=1024; switch to chunked generation + concat.
metadata.comfyui_policy: Do not use ComfyUI for this run unless allocator issue is fixed and verified.
